name: How much does door opening framing usually cost?
description: Price depends on whether the opening is structural, how much framing must be rebuilt, and whether hidden wall damage is found.

mainEntity.name: How much does door opening framing usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost varies with demolition, structural work, and whether the opening needs new framing members or permit-related revisions. A basic opening is less expensive than a load-bearing change, and any surprise damage inside the wall can increase the final price.
